# Asset provenance

Original geometric Vistara icons (16/32/48/128 PNG) and original locally generated scene SVG artwork are included under the repository MIT license. Scene definitions live in `src/shared/scenes.ts`; images are generated as local SVG data URLs and have no remote resources. Themes use local CSS gradients and installed/system fonts. No external logos, anime characters, licensed stock packs or CDN assets are bundled. User-uploaded images remain under the user's rights and control.
